{{Top|leg}}
'''Anrick''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who was a good friend of the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Mikos Argdran]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Anrick transported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operative [[Shondra Del]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] while she was on the run from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. Shortly afterward, Argdran and a group of Rebel agents journeyed to Merisee in search of Del. On arrival on the world, Argdran [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Anrick to ask for information regarding her whereabouts, and Anrick told him that Del had headed into [[Caronath]], the world's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Operation: Elrood book">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref>
